svg.text: MiniMax M3 · data_collection:deny · L3 divergence auditor · real transcript
ERROR: Refusing to send possible secret-bearing content. Matched: OPENROUTER_API_KEY,
↑ the egress tripwire fired — the hunk contained secret NAMES, so nothing was sent. Fail-closed.
$ … evaluate() gate hunk (no secret names) | m3-audit "find any tier that can pass without evidence"
| Unknown/malformed tier falls through | P0 | a tier outside L0–L3 skips every
reviewer check — passes on tests alone, contradicting "fail closed". Normalize + reject. |
| tests trusted on status string alone | P2 | a forged {"status":"pass"} clears if the
command matches — require exit_code==0 + a log hash. |
**Summary:** the code-visible P0 is the unknown-tier fall-through; two more P0s are
"pending — unverifiable from this snippet" and must be checked against the full function.
M3's job is DIVERGENCE — a 4th-lineage voice that surfaces what to re-verify.
Every finding is verified against the real code — no model is an authority (the tier guard lives upstream in cmd_gate).
